meta.name: wcag-audit-patterns
meta.description: Conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits with automated testing, manual verification, and remediation guidance. Use when auditing websites for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网站无障碍并给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要满足 WCAG 无障碍标准且不确定从何入手。
copy.tagline_en: Audit website accessibility and get fix guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible to people with disabilities and meet WCAG standards.

howto.what: Claude 会按 WCAG 2.2 对网页做无障碍审计:先跑自动化检测,再人工核验,并给出修复建议;也能按无障碍模式帮你实现组件。
howto.when: 当你要求审计网站无障碍、修复 WCAG 违规,或准备 ADA/Section 508、VPAT 等合规时触发。

say.text: 帮我按 WCAG 2.2 AA 审计这个页面的无障碍问题
say.note: 会列出违规项和修复建议

say.text: 这个表单缺少标签,怎么改才能符合 WCAG?
帮我做一个键盘可用的下拉菜单组件
say.note: 按无障碍模式给实现方案

howto.what_en: Claude audits web content against WCAG 2.2: automated testing plus manual verification, with remediation guidance, and can help implement accessible components.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you audit a site for accessibility, fix WCAG violations, implement accessible components, or prepare for ADA/Section 508 or VPAT compliance.
